html:
This tour takes you to the pristine Hon Tam Island ( Nha Trang ), a perfect destination to relax, swim, and enjoy natural wellness experiences. Escape the city and indulge in hot mineral baths, hydrotherapy, and beachside leisure in a tropical paradise.

ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30
Pick-up by car and English-speaking guide from your hotel or meeting point. Depart for Hon Tam Island.

09:00
Board a canoe to reach Hon Tam Island.

09:15 – 11:30
Enjoy a range of relaxing island activities:

  • Free use of towels, bathing suits, and lockers

  • 20-minute mineral or herbal mud bath

  • Full-body massage with hydrotherapy system

  • Free access to a 1,350 m² hot mineral water pool and overflowing mineral pool

  • Time to swim, sunbathe, and take photos

11:30
Lunch at the island restaurant. Afterward, relax and enjoy the island’s facilities.

15:00 – 15:30
Return to the mainland by canoe. Tour ends with drop-off at your hotel.

TOUR PRICE: USD 58 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Hotel pick-up and drop-off by car

  • Canoe transfer to and from Hon Tam Island

  • Lunch on the island

  • English-speaking guide

  • Entrance ticket to Hon Tam Island

  • Bottled water

  • Hot mineral mud bath ticket

  • Chairs and huts for resting

EXCLUSIONS

  • VAT

  • Personal expenses

  • Optional services outside the program

CHILDREN POLICY

  • Children under 1 m: Free

  • 1 m – 1.29 m: 70% of adult ticket price

  • Above 1.29 m: Full adult price
outline: Day 1: NHA TRANG BEACH – HON TAM ISLAND TOUR
